title: RankBriding
description: This is a minecraft plugin create to allow admin's to give a user a minecraft rank and discord rank by hosting the bot on the server itself and allowing it to send commands
body:
This plugin requires **Luckperms** to run,

Even though this plugin requires Luckperms to run you are able to use different ranking systems.

**If your bot token ever gets leaked RESET it Immediatly, even if you arent sure they saw it RESET it immedialty!**

The plugin allows any user to link their minecraft account to their discord account,
this allows admins and managers to give members their roles they need.

**Commands:**\
/promote {user} {rank}\
/demote {user} {rank}\
/link {code} (Get the code by running the /link command in game)\
/lpinfo {user} (Doesnt have to be linked, optional command can be removed in the config.yml)\
/logconnect {channel} (Assigns the channel everything will be logged in)

**Contact**\
If you plugin is running into issues please join our discord on the right,
If you dont have discord or cant join please contact Bluebloks2@gmail.com or qitzblue on discord
